// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
  int last_i0_staged = -1;

  gemmini_flush(0);

  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
    if (ncols <= 0) continue;
    if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;

    // Stage B scales once per j0 column-block.
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
      memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);

    for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;

      // Stage A scales only when i0 changes.
      if (i0 != last_i0_staged) {
        for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
          memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
        last_i0_staged = i0;
      }

      int tiles   = BLK / DIM;
      int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
      uint32_t a_base   = 0;
      uint32_t b_base   = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles * tiles_K * DIM;
      int      SPAD_DEST = 128;
      int pad_i = BLK - mrows;
      int pad_j = BLK - ncols;

      // Step 1: config_ex — FP8 E4M3 inputs, BF16 output, no LUT.
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                   1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

      // Step 2: Load A scales (sel=0) then B scales (sel=1).
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);

      // Step 3: MVIN A tiles into scratchpad via mvin port.
      //         Stride = full K row width in bytes.
      gemmini_extended3_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t), MVIN_SCALE_IDENTITY, false, 0);
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
              (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
              a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM,
              DIM, DIM);
        }
      }

      // Step 4: MVIN B tiles into scratchpad via mvin2 port.
      //         B layout: b_base + (j*tiles_K + k)*DIM  (doc-specified).
      //         Stride = full N row width in bytes.
      gemmini_extended3_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t), MVIN_SCALE_IDENTITY, false, 1);
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          gemmini_extended_mvin2(
              (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
              b_base + (j * tiles_K + k) * DIM,
              DIM, DIM);
        }
      }

      // Step 5: Configure requantized mvout.
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors,
                                    tiles, tiles, tiles_K,
                                    0, 0, 1);

      // Step 6: Fused hardware weight-stationary tiled matmul.
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0,
                            a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                            false, false, false, false, false,
                            NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Step 7: Drain BF16-packed results from mx_smem to DRAM, then fence.
      gemmini_mx_read_smem((uint64_t)(&C_hw[i0 * BLK][j0 * BLK]),
                            SPAD_DEST * 16, mrows * ncols);
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
